timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,542.7 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has weakened to a 17-year high of 1,542.7 KRW per USD, meaning you need significantly more won to purchase $2,000 each month. This is the worst exchange rate in nearly two decades, making your monthly dollar obligation unusually expensive right now.

TIP: Since you must convert $2,000 monthly regardless, consider locking in forward contracts or splitting purchases across weeks to average out the impact, rather than converting the full amount on a single day during this unfavorable rate environment.
